title: Sumo Wrestling Arena
prompt:
Create an interactive 3D sumo wrestling game using Three.js where two vehicles (represented by Ferrari models) push each other in a circular arena. Load the model 'ferrari.glb' using GLTFLoader for both players (clone for the second). The scene must include:

## Scene Setup
- A circular arena (dohyo) of radius 8 units, represented as a flat cylinder (radius=8, height=0.3) with a sandy/tan color (0xD2B48C) and a thick red circular border ring on top (torus or ring at edge).
- The arena sits on a dark green ground plane (50x50).
- Camera: PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 15, 18) looking at origin.
- Lights: AmbientLight (0xffffff, 0.5) and DirectionalLight (0xffffff, 0.8) at (10, 20, 10).
- Background color: 0x87CEEB (sky blue).

## Players
- Player 1 (red tint): Load 'ferrari.glb', scale to fit ~1.5 units wide, apply red emissive tint. Start at position (-3, 0.3, 0), facing +X.
- Player 2 (blue tint): Clone the model, apply blue emissive tint. Start at position (3, 0.3, 0), facing -X.
- Each player has: mass=1.0, velocity (vx, vz), health=100, stamina=100.
- Players should have visible health bars (HTML div overlays) above them, colored red for P1 and blue for P2.

## Physics & Game Rules
- Implement simple 2D physics on the XZ plane. Each frame, apply friction (multiply velocity by 0.95).
- Collision detection: When distance between player centers < 2.0, apply elastic-like push force. The player with more momentum pushes the other. Both lose health proportional to collision speed (speed * 5 per collision frame).
- Ring-out detection: If a player's distance from origin > 8.0, they are pushed out and lose the round instantly.
- Stamina regenerates at 0.5 per frame when not charging, capped at 100.

## Controls
- Player 1: WASD keys for movement (apply force 0.15 per frame in direction). Hold SHIFT for charge (force doubles to 0.30 but drains stamina by 2/frame).
- Player 2: Arrow keys for movement (same force). Hold SPACE for charge.
- Press 'R' to reset the match.
- Press 'P' to pause/unpause.

## HUD / UI
- Top-left: 'Player 1 HP: XXX | Stamina: XXX' in red text.
- Top-right: 'Player 2 HP: XXX | Stamina: XXX' in blue text.
- Center-top: 'Round: X | P1 Wins: X | P2 Wins: X' display.
- When a player wins (opponent HP<=0 or ring-out), show a centered banner 'PLAYER X WINS!' for 3 seconds, then auto-reset.
- A 'Start' button (id='startBtn') that begins the match. Before clicking, players cannot move.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- gameStarted: boolean
- paused: boolean
- round: number (starts at 1)
- p1: { x, z, vx, vz, health, stamina, wins, charging }
- p2: { x, z, vx, vz, health, stamina, wins, charging }
- lastCollisionSpeed: number (magnitude of relative velocity at last collision)
- winner: null | 1 | 2
- ringOutPlayer: null | 1 | 2
- matchActive: boolean (true during active play, false when someone won)
- frameCount: number (increments each animation frame)

Update __3D_STATE__ every frame. Ensure all numerical values are never NaN.
physics_constraints: 2D XZ-plane physics with friction coefficient 0.95/frame. Collision when distance < 2.0 applies repulsive force based on relative momentum. Ring boundary at radius 8.0 from origin. Health decreases by relativeSpeed*5 on collision frames. Stamina drains at 2/frame when charging, regenerates at 0.5/frame otherwise, clamped [0,100]. Health clamped [0,100].
